summary: Router 0.42.5 closes TM-03's next action 'consider dropping unsafe-inline for styles' (ADR-0130, proposed, supersedes ADR-0128 whose script decision stays). Before, the control port's CSP allowed style-src 'unsafe-inline' because ui.html had a <style> element and the page plus the markup ui.js builds had 52 style attributes; injected markup could lay a disguised overlay over a control (click redirection with the operator's session) or hide/fake a warning. Now the <style> element is router/ui.css (content unchanged), loaded with <link rel=stylesheet href=ui.css>; 48 static style attributes became utility classes (merged into existing class attributes, !important so they keep a style attribute's precedence over element rules such as select {width:100%}); 3 legend colours became classes pal0..pal7 via palClass(i) with PAL's colours; the budget bar width moved to data-pct and is set through CSSOM after rendering (Number() of the attribute, so only a number reaches the style). Policy: style-src 'self' (no 'unsafe-inline' anywhere on the control port). Traced B2: /ui.css is a GET route on the control app; basic_auth_middleware exempts only /v1/, so it needs the control login like / and /ui.js (tested: 401 without login, headers on success and refusal); the handler serves one fixed path next to ui.html (no request-derived path), Content-Type text/css, Cache-Control no-store. browser_headers.install applies the CSP to the new response. ui.css loads nothing (no url(), no @import), so img-src/default-src stay untouched. Shipping: install.sh requires and copies ui.css, router/Dockerfile copies it, deploy.py uploads it with mode 0644 like ui.js. Nothing else of the control UI's behaviour changes: no action, handler or data path changed; the script change is palClass, data-pct and the CSSOM loop. Residual: script code may still set styles through CSSOM, which injected markup cannot reach; style hashes/nonces were not needed.

findings.evidence: The first generated ui.css put !important only on the last declaration of .flex-row-4 (display:flex; gap:4px; align-items:center !important) and none on the legend classes, so element rules could have won where the former style attribute had won.
findings.resolution: Every declaration of the utility and legend classes carries !important; in a browser all 91 elements with a utility or legend class have the same computed style and position as with the former style set inline.

tests.evidence: 13 tests OK. New: style-src exactly 'self' and no 'unsafe-inline' in the policy; /ui.css 200 with text/css, no-store and the control headers, 401 without login (rejected case); no style element or attribute in ui.html or ui.js and no setAttribute('style') (the same patterns find 31 + 21 attributes and the element in origin/main's files); exactly one style sheet ui.css; every utility class used is defined; legend classes equal PAL; ui.css has no url() or @import.

Response CSP style-src 'self'; only /ui.css loaded (123 rules). For each of the 91 elements with a utility or legend class: every computed property and the bounding rectangle equal those with the classes removed and the former declarations set inline through CSSOM (0 differences). Injected style attribute (full-screen red overlay) and injected <style> element were blocked as style-src-attr and style-src-elem violations; the overlay did not render (position static, no background). Fresh tab through all six tabs plus one live refresh: no console message, no violation. Budget bar with 42 % and 130 %: width 42 % and 100 % through CSSOM.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check ., router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure and node --check router/ui.js
tests.evidence: 93 commands, 0 failed; includes selftest_browser, selftest_install (its install.sh run is skipped on Windows; CI runs it on Linux), check_adr_index (130 ADRs), check_control_flow.
run after staging this record; added lines are CSS, class names, code, documentation.

limitations: install.sh's copy of ui.css is exercised by selftest_install on Linux (CI), not locally on Windows; the container image build is CI's container job.
Admin access segmentation (TM-03's remaining next action) and stolen admin credentials are out of scope.
